summary: Verified end-to-end 'Not expected' weekday (dow_hours.off) feature — backend grid NE classification, totals exclusion, presence 'Not scheduled', and frontend DOW editor. Found and fixed 2 real bugs blocking the feature (UserPublic schema + presence_board typo). Final: 7/7 backend tests pass; frontend verified via Playwright.
action_items: Two bugs were fixed by the testing agent — main agent should review the fixes: (1) /app/backend/models.py UserPublic.dow_hours typed Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] rejected boolean 'off' with 500 on every member save response; widened to Dict[str, Any]. (2) /app/backend/routes/presence_board.py line 429 called target_date.weekday() where target_date is a str (ISO date), causing 500 on every /api/presence call; replaced with today_d.weekday().
critical_code_review_comments: models.UserPublic.dow_hours schema was out of sync with routes/members.py MemberCreate/MemberUpdate — fixed. Consider sharing the type alias so this doesn't drift again.

presence_board.py bug would have crashed the Presence Board for ALL users (not just part-timers) since the new elif runs unconditionally. Add a unit test that fetches /api/presence to catch this regression.

DowHoursEditor 'Off' label in the UI reads just 'Off' with a tooltip 'Not expected on this day...'; consider renaming the inline label to 'Not expected' to match the spec and the Grid legend (currently relies on tooltip for context).
seed_data_creation: Created disposable staff member TEST_notexp_iter119@attendance.app during tests; auto-deleted at module teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fixes applied: models.UserPublic.dow_hours now Dict[str, Any]; presence_board.py:429 uses today_d.weekday() instead of target_date.weekday(). All 7 tests in test_not_expected_dow_iter119.py pass. Frontend: mf-dow-<dow>-off checkboxes present on MemberForm (verified via click-first-edit-button flow), of-dow does NOT render them, Grid legend shows 'NE Not expected'. Note the MemberForm renders as a modal overlay, not a separate route — double-click opens inline column edit; the pencil icon in the Actions column opens the full form.
rca of the issue: Bug 1 (UserPublic.dow_hours): When MemberCreate/MemberUpdate was widened to Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] to accept 'off: True', the response_model UserPublic was not updated. FastAPI validates the response doc against the model, and {mon: {off: True}} on an existing user raised ValidationError → 500. Fix: widen UserPublic.dow_hours to Dict[str, Any]. Bug 2 (presence_board): The newly-added elif used target_date.weekday() but target_date is already-ISO string (target_dt or today_d is the date object). Fix: swap to today_d.weekday().
